scope: Deterministic C0/C1 development baselines only; neither neural training nor clinical qualification is authorized by this protocol.

endpoint_definition.censoring_rule: For OS.EVENT=0, right-censor at the supplied OS.TIME from diagnosis. The user describes follow-up as "censoring till now"; the hash-bound supplied durations remain unchanged.
endpoint_definition.confirmation_source: User responses: "Unit in days, 1 as decease" and "diagnosis, censoring till now".
endpoint_definition.administrative_cutoff_note: No explicit calendar cutoff was supplied. Do not substitute the conversation date or extend observed durations using the system clock.
endpoint_definition.duration_policy: Use OS.TIME as supplied in the frozen source CSV; no recalculation or follow-up extension.

evaluation.ibs_interval_rule: 210-to-730 days, at 30-day steps plus 365 and 730. Lower bound is first 30-day grid point strictly above the larger training/validation minimum follow-up (10/194 days). Selected from development support before any held-out model predictions; no test-derived retuning.
evaluation.fallback_rule: Before held-out model comparison, retain only horizons with positive training censoring survival, observed follow-up beyond the horizon and observed events in both train and validation. If 730 is unsupported, propose 365 in a new version before fitting/scoring; do not silently shorten after test results. Unsupported test metrics are unassessable, not retuned.

clinical.coding_source: User approval on 2026-10-28 of AGE continuous, coded fields categorical and TX excluded; retain the original source categories without semantic recoding.

NSTAGE.justification: User confirmed on 2026-10-28 that NSTAGE is derived from T/N/M. Retain categorical T, N and M and omit their derived NSTAGE column to avoid redundant staging.

clinical.staging_decision: Use categorical T, N and M; omit the user-confirmed derived NSTAGE column. Preserve the other approved clinical inputs and raw categories.
clinical.coding_notes: Raw categorical encoding is approved. Preserve distinctions including N2A/N2B/N2C, T4B and nd/ND. User confirmed NSTAGE is derived from T/N/M; omit only that redundant field. No staging edition or other category meanings are inferred.

accepted_limitations: Original CT and RTSTRUCT sources are unavailable in this input delivery.
Stored CT was already normalized/cropped; original preprocessing history is unresolved.
Derived contours are unreviewed; aligned QC does not establish anatomical or clinical accuracy.
Empty or failed legacy contour QC means unavailable annotation, not known disease absence.
The intensity threshold is a development tissue candidate and makes no HU interpretation.
These inputs are development-only and do not establish clinical performance or an untouched evaluation cohort.
Qualification is computational metadata review: no new CT/mask-byte, 3D support, HU, or anatomical verification.
Source-boundary-limited shells and flagged reference/model volume changes are retained under the unchanged common-grid policy; missing source tissue is not reconstructed.
Reference geometry remains valid only where its recorded validity mask is true; unavailable laterality and anatomical node counts are not replaced with observed zeros.
The six displayed-panel inspections are limited evidence; the original visual/clinical review fields remain pending or not established.
Eligibility is the existing OS-valid inventory; unavailable compartments are masked rather than converted to disease absence or used as patient exclusions.

baseline_execution.unsupported_test_metrics: unassessable; preserve fits and predictions; do not retune horizons, remove patients or refit from test outcomes
